# Rishav Nandi

> Personal website of Rishav Nandi, an AI Platform Engineer and DevOps practitioner from India focused on AI infrastructure, automation, open-source software, and self-hosted systems.

Use the homepage for Rishav's profile and experience, the projects page for his public work, and the posts below for technical tutorials.

## Main pages

- [Homepage](https://www.rishavnandi.com/): Profile, experience, featured projects, and latest writing
- [Projects](https://www.rishavnandi.com/projects): Public open-source projects and repositories
- [Posts](https://www.rishavnandi.com/posts): Technical writing and tutorials

## Posts

- [Automate your homelab setup with Ansible](https://www.rishavnandi.com/post/homelab): Tutorial for automating a Docker homelab with Ansible
- [Setup Minikube on WSL2](https://www.rishavnandi.com/post/minikube): Tutorial for installing and configuring Minikube on WSL2
